raw.descriptionHtml:
In a world where products and software can be replicated overnight, intellectual property is one of the last durable moats. Stilta builds agentic AI for intellectual property, giving legal and IP teams software that can reason across massive document sets, surface evidence, and produce litigation-grade work faster and more reliably.

We recently raised a $10.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Y Combinator and operators from companies including OpenAI, Legora, and Lovable. We already work with major IP firms and Fortune 500 companies, and we’re at the very beginning of defining what great AI-native software for intellectual property looks like.


About the role

You'll be one of the first hires outside the founding team - four ex-QuantumBlack engineers, now building Stilta. Your decisions will shape the product for years. You'll build across the full stack: multi-agent reasoning pipelines, retrieval over hundreds of millions of patents and scientific literature, and the surfaces that practitioners at top IP firms and Fortune 500 IP teams use daily. These are problems without established patterns. You're building agentic software that patent lawyers actually trust to do substantive work - and you'll define what this category of product looks like.

What you will do

  • Build and improve the multi-agent architecture powering invalidity search, infringement analysis, freedom to operate research, and more

  • Own the full lifecycle of features - from talking to customers about what they need to watching them use it in production

  • Push code to production daily. Your code reaches users in hours or days, not weeks

  • Build retrieval, reasoning, and evaluation systems that run autonomously over millions of documents with reliable source-backed results

  • Set engineering standards for a codebase that will scale to a large team

What we are looking for

  • Exceptional matters more than experienced - we care about what you can do, not how long you've been doing it

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and opinionated about product

  • You write software with and for AI agents, and have shipped agentic systems before

  • You can take a product idea from sketch to production single-handedly - write the specs, build the UI, wire the agent pipeline, deploy the infra

  • Comfortable across Python and TypeScript, and you've worked with enough infrastructure - vector databases, distributed compute, cloud orchestration - that none of it slows you down

  • Experience navigating enterprise requirements - SOC 2, data residency, access controls - is a plus


What we can offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity

  • Unlimited Claude Code - experiment with AI‑assisted workflows, prototypes, and automations from day one

  • A front row seat - you will be shaping the foundation of our business

Stilta are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or background. Selection for this role will be based solely on suitability for the position and does not discriminate on any protected characteristic.

raw.title: Founding GTM Lead
raw.descriptionHtml:
In a world where products and software can be replicated overnight, intellectual property is one of the last durable moats. Stilta builds agentic AI for intellectual property, giving legal and IP teams software that can reason across massive document sets, surface evidence, and produce litigation-grade work faster and more reliably.

We recently raised a $10.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Y Combinator and operators from companies including OpenAI, Legora, and Lovable. We already work with major IP firms and Fortune 500 companies, and we’re at the very beginning of defining what great AI-native software for intellectual property looks like.


About the role

Every deal to date has been closed by the founders - from Global Fortune 500 enterprises to some of the largest IP firms in the world. The product is proven and the pipeline is growing. What's missing is a real sales function.

 

You will be our first GTM hire and the person who builds the sales motion from zero. This is not a role for someone who wants to step into structure - you are the structure. You will run AI-powered outbound at scale, iterate the playbook in real time alongside the founders, and turn a working pipeline into a repeatable engine.

 

What you will do

  • Run AI-native outbound - leverage Claude, AI research tools, and modern sales stack to generate qualified pipeline at a scale that wouldn't be possible without it

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting to close for IP law firms and enterprise IP teams

  • Iterate on and improve the sales playbook alongside the founders

  • Run demos for senior patent attorneys and heads of IP

  • Cultivate relationships with key prospects (incl. travel to clients)

  • Build the sales infrastructure - CRM, pipeline tracking, forecasting - so this function scales well beyond you

 

What we are looking for

  • AI-native operator - you don't just use AI tools, you build with them. Outbound, research, prep, qualification - your workflow is automated where it can be and high-touch where it matters. We're an AI company and our GTM has to reflect that or we lose

  • Enterprise SaaS sales experience with a track record you can walk us through with real numbers - experience selling to enterprise or professional services is a plus

  • You can earn the trust of sophisticated, sceptical buyers - senior patent attorneys who've heard every pitch and need substance, not slides

  • Builder mentality - you design systems and processes, not just close deals

  • Early-stage startup experience is a plus. What's required is hunger, resourcefulness, and the drive to build from zero

What we can offer

  • Competitive Salary + Equity

  • Unlimited Claude Code - experiment with AI‑assisted workflows, prototypes, and automations from day one

  • Sponsored VISA

  • A front row seat - you will be shaping the foundation of our business


|

Stilta are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or background.
